question: Does scriptural meaning bound by Maya-born letters reach the inner supreme speech?
premises: Scriptural meaning can be bound by Maya-born letters.
The inner level consists of supreme speech letters of essential awakening.
Meaning in that outer form does not arrive at that inner level.
inference: Scriptural meaning confined to Maya-born letters does not reach the inner essence of supreme speech.
plain_english: This scriptural meaning, bound by Maya-born letters, has not arrived within as that which consists of the supreme speech-letters of essential awakening.
